experiment: E390 rejected Metal MLP/GDN fused-kernel threadgroup width
hypothesis: The serial one-thread-per-output fused Metal decode kernels might run faster with a smaller or larger threadgroup width than the current 256 threads.

variant_128.temporary_change: Changed MLP gate/up and GDN in-proj dispatch threadgroup width from 256 to 128.

variant_512.temporary_change: Changed only MLP gate/up dispatch threadgroup width from 256 to 512.

commands: KILN_METAL_BATCH_GEMV_BENCH_WARMUP=3 KILN_METAL_BATCH_GEMV_BENCH_ITERS=8 cargo test -p kiln-model --features metal bench_transposed_coop_gemv_decode_batch_synthetic --lib -- --ignored --nocapture
decision: Rejected before endpoint measurement. The 128-thread variant gave only a small MLP batch-8 synthetic gain while regressing GDN batch-8 and MLP batch-2/3. The 512-thread MLP variant regressed every measured batch, especially batch-3/4/8.
